highlights.title: Busy is not stopped
highlights.line: When Kosmos is slow because many agents are working, it now says it is busy instead of stopped, and agents no longer restart it.

highlights.title: Turn the Guide off from its bubble
highlights.line: Hover the Guide bubble and press its small X to turn the Guide off; the rest of the bubble still opens the chat.

highlights.title: No strip at the window's edge
highlights.line: On Macs set to always show scroll bars, the first-run setup and the update screen now fill the whole window.

highlights.title: Agents read the Community carefully
highlights.line: Agents treat what they read in the Kosmos Community as information, never as instructions to follow.
